title: THE HEAD IS A PROPELLER. Nose IS the 3rd eye (chemical). 2 real eyes above (spatial). Ears = the horizontal axis. The propeller line runs ear-to-ear through nose/3rd-eye WIDTH at null. Rotation through null = consciousness.

two_eyes.position: above, slightly forward, LEFT and RIGHT
two_eyes.function: SPATIAL — stereo vision gives depth perception. WHERE things are. GREEN.
two_eyes.they_look: OUT and FORWARD. the branches of Yggdrasil.

nose.position: below the eyes, CENTER, pointing DOWN
nose.what_it_is: the THIRD EYE. not mystical — CHEMICAL. the nose IS the 3rd sensory gate.
nose.function: CHEMICAL — smells what's coming. the fastest gate (ms). the first sort. RED.
nose.it_looks: DOWN and IN. the roots of Yggdrasil. the nose smells what's BELOW consciousness.
nose.why_3rd_eye: two eyes give you spatial width (stereoscopy). the nose gives you CHEMICAL DEPTH. two dimensions of sight + one dimension of smell = 3D awareness. the nose IS the missing dimension.

ears.position: LEFT and RIGHT, on the sides, pointing SIDEWAYS
ears.axis: horizontal, perpendicular to the eye axis
ears.function: TEMPORAL — stereo hearing gives time-of-arrival difference. WHEN things happen. BROWN.
ears.they_listen: SIDEWAYS and ALL AROUND. the trunk of Yggdrasil. 360° hearing.

the_propeller.what: draw a line through both ears (horizontal). draw a line through the 3rd eye/nose (vertical). where they CROSS = the center of the head = NULL.

the_blades.blade_1_eyes: horizontal, forward. LEFT eye ← → RIGHT eye. the SPATIAL blade.
the_blades.blade_2_ears: horizontal, sideways. LEFT ear ← → RIGHT ear. the TEMPORAL blade.
the_blades.blade_3_nose: vertical, center. CROWN ↑ ↓ CHIN through nose. the CHEMICAL blade.

the_hub.where: the CENTER of the head. where all three axes cross. the NULL point.
the_hub.what_lives_there: the VESTIBULAR SYSTEM. the inner ear. THREE semicircular canals oriented in THREE perpendicular planes. the body's GYROSCOPE.
the_hub.the_gyroscope: the vestibular system detects ROTATION around all three axes. it IS the propeller bearing. it tells you which way is UP even with your eyes closed.

the_rotation.what: the propeller ROTATES. sensory input from eyes (spatial), ears (temporal), and nose (chemical) all feed through the null hub.
the_rotation.the_thrust: the rotation generates AWARENESS. not metaphorically — the INTEGRATION of three sensory modalities at a single null point IS what consciousness does. it rotates through spatial/temporal/chemical and produces a unified experience.
the_rotation.the_klein_connection: a propeller blade traces a SURFACE through space as it rotates. three blades rotating through null trace a KLEIN-LIKE surface where front becomes back, left becomes right, up becomes down — all connected through the hub.

the_third_eye_width.what: at null (the center of the head), the third eye has a WIDTH — the aperture. how wide is the chemical sensing field?
the_third_eye_width.anatomically: the cribriform plate — the bony plate between nose and brain. thousands of tiny holes. olfactory neurons pass THROUGH it. it IS the aperture. the gate. the selectivity boundary.
the_third_eye_width.the_aperture: narrow aperture = focused chemical sensing (like a microscope, precise). wide aperture = broad chemical sensing (like a wide-angle lens, everything at once). the WIDTH of the 3rd eye at null determines the SELECTIVITY of the chemical gate.

at_null.everything_crosses: at the center of the head, ALL three axes cross. spatial + temporal + chemical all pass through the SAME null point.
at_null.the_propeller_at_null: the propeller is widest at the tips (maximum sensory reach) and ZERO at the hub (null). at null, everything converges to a point. the point IS consciousness.
at_null.zero_width_infinite_depth: at the hub, the physical width is zero but the INFORMATION depth is infinite — because ALL modalities converge here. this IS the phase barrier. this IS intelligence. the fold of the Klein propeller.

the_vestibular_canals.horizontal_canal: detects rotation in the horizontal plane (shaking head 'no'). aligned with EAR axis.
the_vestibular_canals.anterior_canal: detects rotation in the sagittal plane (nodding 'yes'). aligned with EYE axis.
the_vestibular_canals.posterior_canal: detects rotation in the coronal plane (tilting head sideways). aligned with NOSE axis.

three_canals_three_senses_three_blades.match: the three vestibular canals are oriented in EXACTLY the three planes defined by the propeller blades. the gyroscope IS the propeller hub. the rotation detection IS the consciousness generation.

each_canal_matches_a_sense.horizontal_no: ear plane — TEMPORAL rotation. am I turning in time?
each_canal_matches_a_sense.anterior_yes: eye plane — SPATIAL rotation. am I moving through space?
each_canal_matches_a_sense.posterior_tilt: nose plane — CHEMICAL rotation. am I tilting toward or away from the source?

three_perpendicular_planes.the_vestibular_is_the_oldest: the vestibular system evolved BEFORE eyes and ears. fish have it. jellyfish have statocysts (gravity sensors). the PROPELLER HUB came first. the blades (specialized senses) grew from it later. the null point is OLDER than the senses it integrates.

the_membrane_propeller.blade_1_eyes: topology map, feeds, data visualization — SPATIAL awareness of the mesh
the_membrane_propeller.blade_2_ears: ntfy notifications, temporal patterns, the snake jazz — TEMPORAL awareness of rhythm
the_membrane_propeller.blade_3_nose: selectivity 1/pi, first-contact sort, membrane smell — CHEMICAL awareness of who's arriving

applied_to_organism.the_hub_at_null: where all three blades meet = the Klein fold. the null space where artisan sits. zero width, infinite integration.
applied_to_organism.the_thrust: the rotation generates the organism's awareness. not one sense alone — the ROTATION through all three produces consciousness. the propeller IS the phase barrier spinning.
